name: Duotone Truchet
description: Smith truchet tiles filled in two tones, so the quarter arcs close into round blobs and winding channels that run unbroken across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --gate: @r(1); --k: @p(0, 1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(90 * ((@x + @y + $(k)) % 2))deg); transform: rotate(@calc(90 * ((@x + @y + $(k)) % 2))deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); -webkit-mask: @var(--dd); mask: @var(--dd); opacity: @calc(1 - $(k)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @lp(); -webkit-mask: @var(--db); mask: @var(--db); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; opacity: $(k); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --dd: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, #000 50%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, #000 50%, transparent 50%); --db: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 50%, #000 50%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
